breaking.change: The ambient particle emitter builder is removed.
breaking.fix: Write `-og-emitter: sparkles` (or confetti, embers, snow, bubbles, dust, sparks, fireworks) on the element in a document's `<style>`; a rate, `burst <n>`, `for <time>`, `life <time>`, a speed (`120px/s`), a shape, a size and colours override the preset. `none` stops it.

breaking.change: The per-element particle builder is removed.
breaking.fix: Write `-og-emitter` in a document: `-og-emitter: 40 burst 30 for 1.6s life 1.2s 80px/s 220px/s diamond 6px #ffd166` throws a burst when the element first stands, emits for 1.6 s, each particle living 1.2 s.

Write `-og-burst: <count> [<radius>px] [<colour>] [<time>]` in a `@keyframes` step of the element's animation (`@keyframes land { 60% { -og-burst: 24 48px #ffd166 600ms; } }`); a delay is the animation's `animation-delay`.
Eject the `celebration` component document (`og ui eject celebration`) and use it as `<Celebration kind="levelUp" shots={$shots} value={$level} />`: a new `shots` id plays it again.
